alex (new hire): hey folks, first week — trying to get onto dashboards and set up alert subscriptions. I can see metrics in Datadog but I can't add myself to monitor notifications; the 'Add channel' dropdown is empty. any tips?
priya (observability): welcome! dropdown empty usually means the Datadog Slack integration hasn't been granted permission to post to that channel. Check with infra if #team-alerts was added in Datadog -> Integrations -> Slack -> Channels.
alex (new hire): ok sounds like infra. also, I tried to star a Grafana dashboard but the star button is disabled.
raj (infra): that star is disabled if you lack 'viewer' scope in the org or if the dashboard is in a locked folder. we lock some folders for prod dashboards. if you need a copy, use 'Share -> Export -> Save JSON' and import to your personal folder.
alex (new hire): quick question: can I test Datadog webhook alerts locally? I'd like to run a curl to simulate payload.
priya (observability): yes, here's a sample payload you can POST to a requestbin or local ngrok endpoint:
```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"test alert","text":"hello from alex","alert_id":123}' https://your-test-endpoint.example
```
raj (infra): also remember that SSO accounts need to be provisioned in Sentry. If you can't see a project, request 'sentry-project-read' via the access form and include the org and project slug.
alex (new hire): where's the access form? tried the handbook link but it 404s.
devex-bot: Access request portal moved to https://redwood.company/internal/access-requests — use that and select the specific tool action (e.g., 'Grafana - Dashboard Copy', 'Datadog - Monitor Edit', 'Sentry - Project Read').
alex (new hire): submitted Grafana copy request (ID #4799) and Datadog monitor edit (ID #4800). thanks!
infra-bot: Request #4800 received; approvers: datadog-admins. ETA 8 business hours.
priya (observability): one last tip: for long-term dashboard integrations (embedding into docs), request a service account and ask infra to create an embed token scoped to the dashboard UID; explain the use case in the form.
alex (new hire): perfect — will follow up if anything else blocks. thanks everybody :raised_hands:
